user_reported_bug: When I try to change thumbnail for an already-uploaded video I get: 'Save failed: Update failed: KeyError: uploader_id'. Also subtitle upload still fails with the same error as before.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend verification seeded a legacy MongoDB video without uploader_id plus a normal owned video, then tested PATCH ownership scenarios and subtitle upload. The PATCH thumbnail/update path is fixed for the requested admin/non-admin/owner cases, but subtitle upload to a legacy video still returns HTTP 500 with KeyError: uploader_id, so the full user-reported bug is not fixed.

critical.issue: Legacy video docs missing uploader_id still crash in add_subtitle at /app/backend/server.py:2458 because it uses v["uploader_id"] unconditionally. Reproduced as admin with a .vtt upload: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error; backend log shows KeyError: 'uploader_id'.

action_items: Apply the same legacy-safe ownership guard used in PATCH /api/videos/{id} to POST /api/videos/{id}/subtitles: use v.get('uploader_id') or '' and allow admin fallback while denying non-admin legacy edits.
Consider auditing related video endpoints that still use v["uploader_id"] directly (for example DELETE video/subtitle) for the same migrated-document crash pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/videos/{id} now uses v.get('uploader_id') and passed all five requested PATCH cases, including normalized synopsis on legacy docs.
Subtitle upload was not updated: /app/backend/server.py line 2458 still reads v["uploader_id"] unconditionally, causing the exact remaining user symptom on legacy docs.
seed_data_creation: Created two temporary users and two temporary video docs: one legacy video missing uploader_id and synopsis, one normal video with uploader_id. All seeded docs/users were deleted in script cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/test_reports/bug_verification_16.py after fixing add_subtitle. Expected all checks to pass, especially POST .vtt subtitle to a legacy missing-uploader_id video as admin should no longer return 500/KeyError.
rca_of_the_issue: The thumbnail/PATCH code path was fixed, but the subtitle upload endpoint retains the original unsafe ownership check. Repro: seed a video document without uploader_id, login as admin, POST multipart .vtt to /api/videos/{legacy_id}/subtitles; response is 500 and backend log points to KeyError at server.py:2458.
